senses.gloss:
नुनुत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, desirous of impelling or
inciting or removing.

नुन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, pushed, propelled; pushed
away; thrown, cast; dismissed, sent, despatched.

नूनम् नूनम्, ind. (fr. 1. नु), now, at
present (Ved.); just now, just, exactly (Ved.); im-
mediately (Ved.); from this time forward, for
the future (Ved.); now then, therefore (Ved.);
probably, in all probability, perhaps; without doubt,
certainly, assuredly, surely, indeed.
—नून-भाव,
अस्, m. probability; (आत्), ind. in all probability,
probably, indeed.
